title: 第859章 甜第858章 林蔓我爱你
slug: 领证爽约我转嫁你哥哭什么
content_zh:
林蔓的鼻头再次一阵酸涩，眼眶又在发热了。
她单薄瘦削的身体往他怀里拱了拱，小脑袋在他的身上蹭了蹭，似乎在确认他的怀抱。
那种小心翼翼试探的姿态刺痛了沈云翔的心。
他把林蔓抱得更紧。
接着便听到林蔓细细软软的声音，浸染着委屈的哭音。
“我也爱你，真的。对不起，是我错了。”
沈云翔的呼吸喷在她的颈侧，却不带半点情欲，只有心疼和怜爱。
“我明白，你现在什么都不用说，好好睡一觉，有什么事情我们过后再说。”
林蔓轻轻地“嗯”了声，眼底的湿热顺着眼角滑落，漫过鼻梁，抵入鬓角。
她真的累了，很久很久没有试过这么安心躺在他的怀里。
林蔓的眼皮逐渐沉重，感受着他的温暖，不知不觉闭上眼睛睡了过去。
这一觉，她睡到第二天下午3点才自然醒。
很久没有这么踏实过了。
沈云翔一直守在她身边，陪着她。
本来想起身的，可他刚动一下，林蔓就皱起眉头，发出那种不安稳的哼哼唧唧声。
沈云翔又心疼地躺下，一直抱着她，陪着她入睡。
维持着从后面抱着她的姿势，一直没动。
他闻着她身上的馨香，几次忍不住吻了又吻她的发。
他是晚上陪她一起入睡，早上不到九点就醒了。
却又就这么一直抱着她，到了现在。

林蔓醒来，发现他还抱着自己，不由得有些担心。
“你手麻不麻？”
林蔓转过身来，吃惊地看着他。
那张巴掌大的小脸看起来更小了，小小的脸上挤着大大的五官。
那双眼睛里透着股小心翼翼，没了以往的尖锐自信。
此时看起来，那眼神透着股茫然与空洞。
这是被长时间折磨过后才有的情况。
沈云翔看着，心疼地蹙起了眉头，回答她的话。
“不麻，跟你一起待着就很舒服。”
林蔓开心地扯了扯裙角：“我睡得很好。”
“嗯，是睡得不错。这段时间你得好好休养一下。”
沈云翔抬手理了理她额前的发，像是在照顾着精致的娃娃一样，那样小心翼翼的爱护。
林蔓又往他怀里拱了拱，脑袋抵着他的下巴。
而后微微仰起头来，笑着说：“一定饿坏了吧？我起床，我们一起下楼吃饭。”
“好。”沈云翔又低头在她额头上轻轻吻了吻。
随后两人一起下床洗漱。
林蔓站在洗漱台前。
沈云翔贴心地给她挤好牙膏，将牙刷递到她面前。
“谢谢。”
林蔓拿过来，不知道是不是那段时间太缺觉了，刷牙这会还觉得有点困。

一头柔顺的发已经变得有些干枯，散落在她的脸颊上，将她那张小脸遮得更加小巧。
沈云翔站在她旁边，目光时时刻刻黏在她脸上。
看着她这副犯困的样子，眼底都是宠溺，忍不住抬手放在她脑袋上揉了揉。
“要是还困的话，一会吃完饭，歇会，继续睡一觉。”
林蔓睁着眼睛，一边刷牙一边乖巧地“嗯”了声。
content_en:
Lin Man's nose felt sour again, and her eyes were burning again.
Her thin body arched into his arms, and her little head rubbed against his, as if to confirm his embrace.
That cautious and tentative attitude hurt Chen Yunxiang's heart.
He hugged Lin Man tighter.
Then Lin Man's thin and soft voice was heard, filled with cries of grievance.
"I love you too, I really do. I'm sorry, it was my fault."
Chen Yunxiang's breath blew on the side of her neck, but there was no trace of lust, only distress and affection.
"I understand. You don't need to say anything now. Have a good sleep. We'll talk about anything later."
Lin Man softly said "hmm", and the heat and moisture in her eyes slid down the corners of her eyes, spread over the bridge of her nose, and reached her temples.
She was really tired. She hadn't lay so peacefully in his arms for a long, long time.
Lin Man's eyelids gradually became heavy, feeling his warmth, she closed her eyes and fell asleep without realizing it.
During this sleep, she slept until 3pm the next day before waking up naturally.
I haven't felt so at ease in a long time.
Chen Yunxiang has always been by her side, accompanying her.
He originally wanted to get up, but as soon as he moved, Lin Man frowned and made an uneasy grunting sound.
Chen Yunxiang lay down again feeling distressed, holding her in his arms and sleeping with her.
He maintained the posture of holding her from behind and never moved.
He smelled the sweet fragrance on her body and couldn't help but kiss her hair again and again several times.
He went to bed with her at night and woke up before nine o'clock in the morning.
But he kept holding her like this, until now.
Lin Man woke up and found that he was still holding her, and couldn't help but feel worried.
"Are your hands numb?"
Lin Man turned around and looked at him in surprise.
The little face the size of a palm looks even smaller, with big facial features squeezed into the small face.
There was a cautious look in those eyes, without the sharp confidence in the past.
At this moment, it seemed that his eyes were blank and empty.
This is what happens after being tortured for a long time.
Chen Yunxiang looked at it, frowned in distress, and answered her words.
"Bu Ma, I feel very comfortable staying with you."
Lin Man tugged at the hem of her skirt happily: "I slept well."
"Well, I slept well. You need to take a good rest during this time."
Chen Yunxiang raised his hand to smooth the hair on her forehead, as if he were taking care of a delicate doll, caring for her with as much care as he did.
Lin Man arched into his arms again, resting her head on his chin.
Then he raised his head slightly and said with a smile: "You must be very hungry, right? I'll get up and we'll go downstairs to eat together."
"Okay." Chen Yunxiang lowered his head and kissed her gently on the forehead.
Then the two of them got out of bed and washed up together.
Lin Man stood in front of the sink.
Chen Yunxiang carefully squeezed the toothpaste for her and handed the toothbrush to her.
"Thank you."
Lin Man took it over. She didn't know if it was because she was too sleepless during that period, but she still felt a little sleepy while brushing her teeth.
Her silky hair had become a little dry and scattered on her cheeks, covering her little face even more delicately.
Chen Yunxiang stood next to her, his eyes always glued to her face.
Seeing her sleepy look, with fondness in her eyes, he couldn't help but raise his hand and put it on her head to rub it.
"If you're still sleepy, finish your meal later, take a break, and then go back to sleep."
Lin Man opened his eyes and said "hmm" obediently while brushing his teeth.
